payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear method for calculating static embeddings using principal components of contextualized representations.

claims.text: Static embeddings for each word are calculated by taking the first principal component of its contextualized representations in a given layer.

The maximum explainable variance (MEV) indicates how well a static embedding can replace a word's contextualized representations, which is limited due to the anisotropic nature of these representations.
Static embeddings can be improved by making them more isotropic, which may enhance their performance on downstream tasks.
